title: Running a pretrained block
text: Queries keys rotated, normalised scaled per head; scores masked additively. input holds two series eight positions; second hides padded prefix three. difference PyTorch single-precision rounding steps.
code: # q, k, v and the output for n positions of b series; mask c(n, n, 1, b) project <- function(x, pos, n, b) {   heads4 <- function(t) zl_reshape(t, c(dh, heads, n, b))   q <- zl_rope(heads4(lin$q(x)), pos, dh, base = 10000, mode = "half")   q <- zl_rms_norm(q, eps = eps) * zl_param_tensor(p, "tfm.q_norm")   q <- q * zl_scale(zl_softplus(zl_param_tensor(p, "tfm.q_scale")), 1.442695 / sqrt(dh))   k <- zl_rope(heads4(lin$k(x)), pos, dh, base = 10000, mode = "half")   k <- zl_rms_norm(k, eps = eps) * zl_param_tensor(p, "tfm.k_norm")   list(q = q, k = k, v = heads4(lin$v(x))) }  x <- st[["input.x"]] mask <- st[["input.mask"]] n <- dim(x)[[2]] b <- dim(x)[[3]] full <- zl_graph(   function(i) {     h <- project(i$x, i$pos, n, b)     per <- function(t) zl_permute(t, c(1, 3, 2, 4))     s <- zl_crossprod(per(h$k), per(h$q))     a <- zl_softmax(s, mask = i$mask, scale = 1)     o <- zl_crossprod(zl_permute(per(h$v), c(2, 1, 3, 4)), a)     lin$o(zl_reshape(per(o), c(dim, n, b)))   },   p,   inputs = list(x = dim(x), pos = zl_int(n), mask = dim(mask)) ) y <- zl_forward(full, list(x = x, pos = seq_len(n) - 1L, mask = mask))$output max(abs(y - st[["output.y"]])) #> [1] 1.490116e-07

Recomputing whole context every step repeats work: keys values past positions change. key-value cache keeps . zulm cache two state tensors: parameters trained, graph writes zl_state_write() reads like parameter. graph built runs per position. run writes new key value row t cache, mask lets query see rows 0 t: decoded positions equal first series whole-context pass within single-precision rounding. cache keeps values c(dh, cap, heads), product attention weights copies whole value cache every step. long caches, keep values transposed instead, state c(1, cap * dh * heads) written one element per row; benchmark script tools/run-benchmarks source package shows layout.
code: cap <- n zl_state(p, "cache.k", c(dh, cap, heads)) zl_state(p, "cache.v", c(dh, cap, heads))  step <- zl_graph(   function(i) {     h <- project(i$x, i$pos, 1, 1)     split <- function(t) zl_permute(zl_reshape(t, c(dh, heads, 1)), c(1, 3, 2))     k <- zl_state_write(zl_param_tensor(p, "cache.k"), split(h$k), i$row)     v <- zl_state_write(zl_param_tensor(p, "cache.v"), split(h$v), i$row)     s <- zl_crossprod(k, split(h$q))                     # c(cap, 1, heads)     a <- zl_softmax(s, mask = i$mask, scale = 1)     o <- zl_crossprod(zl_permute(v, c(2, 1, 3)), a)      # c(dh, 1, heads)     lin$o(zl_reshape(zl_permute(o, c(1, 3, 2)), c(dim, 1)))   },   p,   inputs = list(x = c(dim, 1), pos = zl_int(1), row = zl_int(1), mask = c(cap, 1, 1, 1)) ) decoded <- matrix(0, dim, n) for (t in seq_len(n) - 1L) {   m <- array(ifelse(seq_len(cap) - 1L <= t, 0, -Inf), c(cap, 1, 1, 1))   out <- zl_forward(step, list(x = matrix(x[, t + 1L, 1], dim, 1), pos = t, row = t, mask = m))   decoded[, t + 1L] <- out$output } max(abs(decoded - y[, , 1])) #> [1] 1.192093e-07

title: Training a model
text: Events come synthetic marked process. kinds follow Markov chain four states; values follow autoregression around mean depends kind. batch holds 16 sequences 64 events. event’s features kind, one-hot, four values; targets next event’s kind values.
code: synth_batch <- function(step, n = 64L, b = 16L) {   set.seed(1000L + step)   trans <- matrix(c(     .85, .05, .05, .05,     .10, .80, .05, .05,     .05, .10, .80, .05,     .05, .05, .10, .80   ), 4, byrow = TRUE)   mu <- matrix(c(     1, -1, 0.5, 0, 2, -0.5, 1, -1, 1, 0, -1, 0.5, 1, 0,     0.5, -1, 2, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1, -1, 1, 0, -1, 0.5, 2   ), 7, 4)   kinds <- matrix(0L, n + 1L, b)   y <- array(0, c(7, n + 1L, b))   for (j in seq_len(b)) {     k <- sample.int(4L, 1L)     prev <- rep(0, 7)     for (t in seq_len(n + 1L)) {       k <- sample.int(4L, 1L, prob = trans[k, ])       prev <- 3 * mu[, k] + 0.5 * prev + 0.1 * stats::rnorm(7)       kinds[t, j] <- k - 1L       y[, t, j] <- prev     }   }   hist <- seq_len(n)   feat <- array(0, c(8, n, b))   for (j in seq_len(b)) {     feat[cbind(kinds[hist, j] + 1L, hist, j)] <- 1     feat[5:8, , j] <- y[1:4, hist, j]   }   kind <- kinds[hist + 1L, , drop = FALSE]   list(     feat = feat,     kind = kind,     kind_prob = array(diag(4)[, kind + 1L], c(4, n, b)),     t = array(stats::runif(n * b), c(1, n, b)),     y = y[, hist + 1L, , drop = FALSE]   ) }

title: Training a model
text: Modules declare parameters store return functions apply inside graph. encoder one causal transformer block width 64 four heads; flow head conditioned encoder’s state, next kind flow time adaptive layer normalisation. loss adds kind’s cross-entropy flow-matching loss: noise eps drawn inside graph, targets interpolated towards time t, head learns velocity y - eps.
code: p <- zl_params() m <- list(   emb = zl_linear(p, "in", n_in = 8, n_out = 64),   blk = zl_block(p, "enc", dim = 64, heads = 4, causal = TRUE),   ln = zl_norm(p, "enc.ln", 64),   kind = zl_linear(p, "kind", 64, 4),   kind_emb = zl_embedding(p, "kind.emb", 4, 64),   ada = zl_adaln(p, "flow.ada", dim = 64, cond_dim = 64),   flow_in = zl_linear(p, "flow.in", 7, 64),   flow_out = zl_linear(p, "flow.out", 64, 7) ) zl_param_count(p) #> [1] 77131  # the velocity of the flow at x_t and time t, given the encoder's state z velocity <- function(z, kind, x_t, t) {   cond <- z + m$kind_emb(kind) + zl_time_embedding(t, 64)   m$flow_out(zl_silu(m$ada(zl_rms_norm(m$flow_in(x_t)), cond))) } build <- function(x) {   z <- m$ln(m$blk(m$emb(x$feat)))   ce <- zl_cross_entropy(m$kind(z), x$kind_prob)   eps <- zl_noise_normal(c(7, 64, 16), "x0")   x_t <- (1 - x$t) * eps + x$t * x$y   v <- velocity(z, x$kind, x_t, x$t)   list(loss = ce + zl_mse(v, x$y - eps)) } inputs <- list(   feat = c(8, 64, 16), kind = zl_int(64, 16), kind_prob = c(4, 64, 16),   t = c(1, 64, 16), y = c(7, 64, 16) ) g <- zl_graph(build, p, inputs, loss = "loss") g #> <zl_graph> 105 nodes; inputs feat c(8, 64, 16), kind c(64, 16), kind_prob c(4, 64, 16), t c(1, 64, 16), y c(7, 64, 16); outputs loss; 3.6 Mb
